items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I had Ross Tompkins, Lawrence Marable, Jeff Hamilton. Pick-up groups.

ctx.x: Oh just people you know around town that do it — the guitar player or piano player. I used to work a lot with Frank Strazzeri and he was using Bill Perkins on some things. I don’t get that many gigs as leader, occasionally, I just use some people that might be free © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-

that you work with. I remember doing a gig when I had a little group, at some little restaurant, I had Ross Tompkins, Lawrence Marable, Jeff Hamilton. Pick-up groups. He’s not available, get someone else. Some other thing with John Heard on bass or just some of the better people here that are around that are available.
